I choose: Drop the requirement

One reason for dropping the requirement is that standardized tests can disproportionately affect students from underprivileged backgrounds, who may lack access to adequate test preparation resources. Removing the requirement can help level the playing field and ensure that admissions decisions are based on a more diverse set of criteria, promoting greater equity and inclusivity in higher education.
